shots.speaker: Novi
shots.action: Running & Hopping across forest path, smelling glowing flowers

dialogue.hindi: Good morning Wonder Forest! Wah, kitni pyari subah hai! Chalo dosto, aaj ped pe chadhenge aur khoob masti karenge! Hop, hop, hooray!
dialogue.english: Good morning Wonder Forest! What a beautiful sunny day! Come on friends, let's climb the big tree and have so much fun! Hop, hop, hooray!

shots.motion_prompt: Novi runs and hops along a soft mossy forest path, ears flapping with wind, paws kicking up tiny glowing flower petals, natural weight shift with each hop, wide-eyed excitement

shots.speaker: Mimi
shots.action: Chubby Bear Belly Dance & Berry Munching

dialogue.hindi: Haha! Novi dekho mera berry dance! Pet ko hilaao, gol gol ghoom jaao! Yummy berries in my tummy!
dialogue.english: Haha! Novi look at my berry dance! Wiggle your tummy, spin all around! Yummy berries in my tummy!

shots.motion_prompt: Mimi performs a rhythmic belly-wiggle dance on green grass, shaking hips side to side, throwing hands in the air and laughing, munching a berry, fur reacting to the moves

shots.speaker: Pip
shots.action: Fast Bird Flying & Pointing to High Canopy

dialogue.hindi: Chirp chirp! Ooper dekho, ooper dekho! Sabse unchi daali par chamakta hua Golden Star-Fruit hai!
dialogue.english: Chirp chirp! Look up high, look up high! The glowing Golden Star-Fruit is at the very top branch!

shots.motion_prompt: Pip flutters rapidly in mid-air, doing a small loop and pointing a wing up to a glowing golden star-fruit on the highest branch
shots.camera: low angle looking up, slow tilt

shots.speaker: Toby

dialogue.hindi: Dheere dheere Novi, ghabrana mat! Ek ek kadam aage badhao, tum pakka ped par chadh jaoge!
dialogue.english: Slow and steady Novi, don't worry! Take it step by step, you can climb all the way up!

shots.motion_prompt: Toby takes slow steady steps across marshmallow stepping stones by a crystal brook, nodding encouragement with a gentle smile

shots.speaker: Novi
shots.action: Tree Climbing Physics: Paws gripping bark, pulling body upwards

dialogue.hindi: Main chadhta hoon! Mazbooti se daali pakdi, ek haath ooper, ek paanv ooper! Yay, main kitna ooper aa gaya!
dialogue.english: Here I go! Holding the branch tight, one paw up, one foot up! Yay, look how high I've climbed!

shots.motion_prompt: Novi climbs the rough bark of a giant oak tree, front paws gripping, pulling body weight upward, kicking back legs onto a mossy branch, reaching toward a glowing star-fruit
shots.camera: upward crane shot following the climb

shots.speaker: Novi
shots.action: Treehouse Balcony Victory Dance with High-Fives

dialogue.hindi: Hurray! Main ped ke sabse ooper treehouse me hoon! Chalo sab milkar naacho! Bunny hop dance, left shake, right shake!
dialogue.english: Hurray! I made it to the treetop treehouse! Let's all dance together! Bunny hop dance, shake left, shake right!

shots.motion_prompt: Novi dances a joyful victory dance on a wooden treehouse balcony, stomping tiny blue sneakers, spinning around, high-fiving friends and waving over the railing

shots.speaker: Novi
shots.action: Fast Spiral Rainbow Water Slide Zoom & Water Splash

dialogue.hindi: Aur ab niche aane ka time! Rainbow slide par jump! One, Two, Three... WHOOOOOSH! Ye kitna thrilling hai!
dialogue.english: And now it's time to slide down! Ready for the rainbow slide! One, Two, Three... WHOOOOOSH! This is so fast and fun!

shots.motion_prompt: Novi slides down a curved translucent rainbow water slide at speed, leaning into the banked turn, water droplets spraying, ears streaming back, ecstatic smile
shots.camera: fast tracking shot along the slide

shots.speaker: Mimi
shots.action: Soft Marshmallow Landing, Sharing Fruit & Hugging

dialogue.hindi: Boing! Novi tumne kar dikhaya! Aadha fruit tumhara, aadha mera! Sharing makes us best friends forever!
dialogue.english: Boing! You did it Novi! Half for you, and half for me! Sharing makes us best friends forever!

shots.motion_prompt: Novi lands in a giant fluffy marshmallow pit with a deep soft bounce, pops back up holding a golden star-fruit, Mimi runs in and gives a tight squishy hug, heart bubbles pop around them
